expect_red: leaving a context draws every open part of the new one and none outside it

mutations.contract: Choosing another topology or study draws the open parts of that model and hides the ones outside it.
mutations.note: The mutation draws every open part, so the old model's parts linger in the new one.
mutations.replace: return { sha: sha, visible: true, ghost: !!inCtx[sha] && !!ghost };
